categories.name: CleanTech
categories.description: Clean technology and sustainable energy solutions

questions.text: What is your verified carbon reduction impact?
questions.helpText: Measure actual CO2e reduction with third-party verification (tons/year). IRL 1-2: Planning/estimates, IRL 3-4: Initial measurements, IRL 5-6: Third-party verification, IRL 7-8: Industry certifications (Gold Standard, Verra), IRL 9: Market-leading impact (1M+ tons/year)

options.text: Measured impact with internal validation (100-1K tons CO2e/year)
Market-leading verified impact (100K+ tons CO2e/year, carbon credits issued)

questions.text: What is your renewable energy generation or storage capacity?
questions.helpText: Measure deployed renewable capacity (MW) or storage (MWh). IRL 1-2: Concept design, IRL 3-4: Pilot installations (<1MW), IRL 5-6: Commercial deployments (1-10MW), IRL 7-8: Scale deployments (10-100MW), IRL 9: Utility-scale (100MW+)

questions.text: What is your ESG reporting and certification status?
questions.helpText: Track ESG frameworks and external certifications. IRL 1-2: Planning ESG strategy, IRL 3-4: Internal ESG tracking, IRL 5-6: Third-party audit (GRI, SASB), IRL 7-8: B Corp, CDP A-list, IRL 9: Industry ESG leader with multiple certifications

options.text: ESG report following framework (GRI, SASB, TCFD)
B Corp certified or CDP A-list rating
Industry ESG leader (multiple certifications, public recognition)

questions.text: What energy efficiency improvements do you deliver?
questions.helpText: Measure % energy savings or efficiency gains. IRL 1-2: Modeling efficiency, IRL 3-4: Lab-validated (5-10%), IRL 5-6: Field-validated (10-20%), IRL 7-8: Commercial scale (20-40%), IRL 9: Industry-leading (40%+)

options.text: Field-deployed efficiency gains (20-30%) with customer validation
Commercial scale efficiency (30-40%) with published case studies

questions.text: What is your circular economy or waste reduction achievement?
questions.helpText: Measure waste diversion, recycling rates, or circular material use. IRL 1-2: Designing circular model, IRL 3-4: Pilot circularity (10-25%), IRL 5-6: Proven circularity (25-50%), IRL 7-8: Advanced circularity (50-75%), IRL 9: Near-zero waste (75%+)

options.text: Pilot program with limited circularity (10-25% waste diversion)
Operational circular model (25-50% waste diversion or recycled content)
Proven circular model (50-75% waste diversion) with third-party audit
Advanced circularity (75-90% waste diversion) with certification
Near-zero waste operations (90%+ circularity) with industry recognition

questions.text: What green or sustainable financing have you secured?
questions.helpText: Track green bonds, sustainability-linked loans, or climate finance. IRL 1-2: Exploring green finance, IRL 3-4: Green grants/seed (<$1M), IRL 5-6: Green VC or loans ($1-10M), IRL 7-8: Green bonds or project finance ($10-100M), IRL 9: Large-scale climate finance ($100M+)

options.text: Green grants or sustainability-focused seed funding (<$1M)
Green venture capital or sustainability-linked loans ($1-10M)
Green bonds, project finance, or ESG-linked financing ($10-100M)
Large sustainability-linked financing ($100M-1B) from development banks
Major climate finance ($1B+) from international institutions

questions.text: What is your product life cycle assessment (LCA) status?
questions.helpText: Track cradle-to-grave environmental impact analysis. IRL 1-2: Planning LCA, IRL 3-4: Internal LCA, IRL 5-6: Third-party LCA (ISO 14040), IRL 7-8: EPD (Environmental Product Declaration), IRL 9: Industry-leading LCA with continuous improvement

options.text: Industry-leading LCA with continuous monitoring and improvement

questions.text: What is your grid integration or energy storage capability?
questions.helpText: For energy solutions, measure grid connection and balancing capabilities. IRL 1-2: Concept design, IRL 3-4: Off-grid demo, IRL 5-6: Grid-connected pilot, IRL 7-8: Commercial grid services, IRL 9: Grid-scale services with utility contracts

options.text: Grid-connected pilot projects with basic interconnection
Commercial grid services (frequency regulation, peak shaving)
Advanced grid services with utility partnerships (demand response, VPP)
Grid-scale services with ISO/utility contracts (ancillary services)

questions.text: What cost reduction trajectory has your technology achieved?
questions.helpText: Measure $/unit cost reduction vs. conventional alternatives. IRL 1-2: High cost (2-5x), IRL 3-4: Premium cost (1.5-2x), IRL 5-6: Near parity (1-1.5x), IRL 7-8: Cost competitive (0.8-1x), IRL 9: Cost leader (<0.8x)

questions.text: What corporate or industrial partnerships have you established?
questions.helpText: Track strategic partnerships with enterprises or utilities. IRL 1-2: Prospecting, IRL 3-4: Pilot/POC with 1-2 partners, IRL 5-6: Commercial contracts with 3-10 partners, IRL 7-8: Multiple Fortune 500 partnerships, IRL 9: Industry-transforming partnerships

options.text: Pilot or POC agreements with 1-2 corporate partners
Paid pilots or early contracts with 3-5 partners
Commercial partnerships with 5-10 enterprises or utilities
Strategic partnerships with multiple Fortune 500 companies
Industry-transforming partnerships across sectors (10+ major partners)

questions.text: What regulatory approvals or certifications have you obtained?
questions.helpText: Track environmental permits, safety certifications, and regulatory compliance. IRL 1-2: Identifying requirements, IRL 3-4: Application submitted, IRL 5-6: Local/state approvals, IRL 7-8: Federal/international approvals, IRL 9: Multiple jurisdictions with ongoing compliance

options.text: Federal or equivalent national approvals obtained
International certifications (UL, CE, ISO) in multiple markets
Comprehensive global regulatory compliance with ongoing monitoring

questions.text: What is your manufacturing or deployment scalability?
questions.helpText: Assess production capacity and supply chain readiness. IRL 1-2: Lab-scale, IRL 3-4: Pilot line, IRL 5-6: First commercial facility, IRL 7-8: Multiple facilities or scaled deployment, IRL 9: Global scale with optimized supply chain

options.text: Pilot production line or limited deployment capacity
First commercial manufacturing facility or deployment infrastructure
Scaled production (>1 facility) or multi-market deployment
Multiple facilities with optimized supply chain and logistics
Global scale with resilient supply chain and local manufacturing

questions.text: What impact measurement and monitoring systems do you have?
questions.helpText: Track real-time monitoring of environmental impact. IRL 1-2: Manual estimates, IRL 3-4: Basic tracking, IRL 5-6: Automated monitoring, IRL 7-8: Real-time dashboards with customer access, IRL 9: AI-powered predictive impact analytics

options.text: Automated monitoring systems with monthly/quarterly reports
Advanced analytics with benchmarking and optimization recommendations
AI-powered predictive analytics with continuous improvement loop

questions.text: What climate commitments have you made and validated?
questions.helpText: Track science-based targets and net-zero commitments. IRL 1-2: No formal commitments, IRL 3-4: Internal targets, IRL 5-6: Public commitments, IRL 7-8: SBTi-validated targets, IRL 9: Net-zero commitment with interim targets validated

options.text: Public climate commitments or carbon neutrality goal
Net-zero commitment with validated interim targets and roadmap

questions.text: What is your technology innovation and IP position?
questions.helpText: Assess patents, R&D, and innovation pipeline. IRL 1-2: Early R&D, IRL 3-4: Patents pending, IRL 5-6: Granted patents, IRL 7-8: Strong patent portfolio (10+ patents), IRL 9: Market-leading IP with licensing revenue

options.text: 10-25 patents with strong freedom to operate analysis
Market-leading IP portfolio (25+ patents) with licensing revenue
